notFound.title: Post not found or removed
notFound.body: This post does not exist, was removed, or is not visible with your account.

draft.title: Draft
draft.body: Only people who can edit it see this post. Publish it to make it appear in the feed.

closed.title: Post closed
closed.body: It no longer appears in the feed. Reopen it to publish it again.

hidden.title: Post hidden
hidden.body: The Moddy team hid this post. It can no longer be edited.

expired.title: This post has expired
expired.body: It is no longer in the feed and no longer takes applications.
expired.editor: It is no longer in the feed. Choose a new expiry date to publish it again.

apply.title: Apply
apply.external: Applications go through the recruiter's own site.
apply.dm: Applications go through a Discord direct message to the author of the post.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this post?
confirmDelete.body: "{{title}}" will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
